text_block_list.text:
Inside the bus heading toward the summer 
training camp—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we must polish it during this 
training camp~. My running, so that it may 
even surpass Suzuka-sama's~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: Huh, ah... No, you're totally right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I'm glad I got it right. For a 
moment, I was worried I had said something 
terribly silly~.

That's good. ...No, it's not good. Because 
the goal is all too clear—it's serious.

—Silence Suzuka. Sprints right from the 
start, sprints through the middle, and 
keeps sprinting full throttle all the way 
across the finish line.

Completely flawless. A perfect ideal, an 
impossible daydream. And now, its 
embodiment had appeared.

To win, I have no choice but to surpass 
that ultra-speed at some point in the 
race, but just where?

Long distance is one thing, but when it 
comes to medium distance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I am quite all right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am sure we will be just fine. We have 
overcome everything before this, after 
all~

Her gentle voice encouraged me. Thinking 
that maybe, just maybe...
choice_data_list:
Can you think of any ideas for how you 
want to run?

text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, she didn't seem able to come 
up with concrete plans. Still, there was 
no use despairing over it."

What we should truly rely on this summer 
is, of course—

To compete against such formidable 
opponents, we shall bring together all the 
wisdom of the Mejiro family this summer.
